goal: Produce insights that sound like an elite coach because they reveal relationships, not because they use more technical words.

insight_archetypes.pattern: Visible problem is downstream of an earlier event.
insight_archetypes.example: Your finish changes because your spacing collapses two steps earlier.

insight_archetypes.pattern: A phase has insufficient time reserve, forcing later compression.
insight_archetypes.example: Your turn is not slow; it simply finishes after the ball has already taken away your setup time.

insight_archetypes.pattern: Issue appears only in a specific ball/context class.
insight_archetypes.example: Your backhand is stable on neutral balls; deep balls expose the spacing leak.

insight_archetypes.pattern: A downstream action is helping the player survive an upstream problem.
insight_archetypes.example: The steeper racket path is a rescue, not the root problem.

insight_archetypes.pattern: Player already owns a better solution under comparable conditions.
insight_archetypes.example: Your best reps keep the same swing but preserve one more adjustment step.

insight_archetypes.pattern: Stable useful behavior should be protected while correcting something else.
insight_archetypes.example: Keep this trunk stability; change only the spacing before the swing.

insight_archetypes.pattern: Average technique is acceptable but variability grows in one event window.
insight_archetypes.example: The issue is not your normal contact point; it is the 30% of reps where it collapses under movement.

insight_archetypes.pattern: Mechanics conflict with likely tactical intent/context.
insight_archetypes.example: You use a defensive spacing solution while trying to attack a short ball.

insight_archetypes.pattern: Distribution improves relative to prior sessions.
insight_archetypes.example: Preparation is no longer the limiter; the next bottleneck is recovery.

insight_archetypes.pattern: Interesting hypothesis is deliberately withheld because measurement is not trustworthy.
insight_archetypes.example: Racket-face angle is not graded from this rear view.

insight_archetypes.pattern: A comparable multi-session distribution is stable or has shifted backward without enough evidence to assign a cause.
insight_archetypes.example: Spacing has stopped improving across comparable sessions; keep the cue stable while we test retention.

insight_archetypes.pattern: The same upstream player-level construct is independently supported across multiple stroke families in matched contexts.
insight_archetypes.example: Arrival spacing is the common limiter across your forehand and backhand; train the shared movement skill while keeping each stroke cue specific.

insight_archetypes.pattern: Logged high-effort practice volume rises materially above the athlete's own recent pattern without making a medical or biomechanical load claim.
insight_archetypes.example: Your logged serve attempts jumped above your recent sessions and this block felt hard; consider an easier next block.

hypothesis_contract.causal_language_gate: Use 'caused' only for configured deterministic relationships or validated experimental knowledge. Otherwise use 'likely drives', 'appears to lead to', or 'is consistent with'.

suppression_rules: Suppress a symptom when its likely upstream cause is selected and coaching the symptom would conflict with that correction.
Suppress a metric difference if it has no clear tennis consequence.
Suppress a generic issue when the pattern disappears after context matching.
Suppress redundant insights that would produce the same cue.
Suppress numerical language when the number is less reliable than the qualitative pattern.

player_insight_contract.headline: A specific thesis, preferably contrastive: what is NOT the issue + what IS the issue.
player_insight_contract.proof: 2-3 pieces of traceable evidence from comparable reps.
player_insight_contract.why: One causal chain ending in a tennis consequence.
player_insight_contract.protect: Name a strength that should remain unchanged when relevant.
player_insight_contract.feel: One cue; prefer external/effect-oriented wording when suitable.
player_insight_contract.practice: One constraint or drill linked to the causal mechanism.
player_insight_contract.confidence: Shown only when it materially affects trust/interpretation.
